category_a_business.overview: 미국 최대의 독립 정유사로, 정유, 마케팅, 미드스트림 및 재생 디젤 사업을 영위하는 통합 다운스트림 에너지 기업입니다.
milestones: 2011: Marathon Oil로부터 분사하여 독립 회사로 설립
2018: Andeavor 인수, 미국 최대 정유사로 등극
2021: 재생 디젤 생산 시설 확장 발표
2022: MPLX 지분 조정 및 미드스트림 사업 강화
category_a_business.business_model: 원유 정제, 석유 제품 판매 및 운송, 재생 디젤 생산을 통해 수익을 창출합니다.
category_a_business.value_chain_position: Downstream + 원유를 정제하여 다양한 석유 제품을 생산하고 유통하며, 미드스트림 자산을 통해 운송 및 저장 서비스를 제공합니다.
channels: 직접 딜러 (ARCO 브랜드 등 장기 연료 공급 계약)
category_a_business.key_customers: 특정 고객에 대한 매출 집중도는 낮으며, 다양한 도매 고객, 독립 사업자 및 직접 딜러를 보유하고 있습니다.

competitive_advantages: Energy / Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing 카테고리 — yfinance peer 비교 권장

top_risks.description: Our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be materially and adversely affected by these risks, and, as a result, the trading price of our common stock could decline.
Our operations are subject to business interruptions and present inherent hazards and risks, which could adversely impact our results of operations and financial condition.
We and our third-party vendors and service providers have been and may in the future be subject to cybersecurity events and incidents of varying degrees.
Existing and potential future data privacy laws pose increasingly complex compliance, monitoring and control obligations and could potentially elevate our costs and risk exposure.
As we integrate artificial intelligence technologies into our processes, these technologies may present business, compliance and reputational risks.
Our integration of these technologies, whether developed internally or procured through our third-party service providers, into our processes may result in new or expanded risks and liabilities.

wikipedia_summary: Marathon Petroleum Corporation is an American petroleum refining, marketing, and transportation company headquartered in Findlay, Ohio. The company was a wholly owned subsidiary of Marathon Oil until a corporate spin-off in 2011.
